model.title: Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL establishing the European Union Critical Communication System (EUCCS)

summary.text: This proposal seeks to establish a new system that would help coordinate critical communications across the European Union during emergencies or crises. The system would aim to ensure that important alert and warning information can be effectively shared and distributed to the public when needed.
